definitions.opacity: sigmoid(opacity logit), all PLY records, no pruning
definitions.tangential_radius: Per Gaussian max(exp(float64(stored_float32(scale_0))),exp(float64(stored_float32(scale_1)))); p95 across Gaussians. Mathematical radius, not 3-sigma footprint or diameter; avoids CPU/CUDA float32 exp ULP mismatch at a cap. Axis 2 is never substituted by sorting.
definitions.voxel_multiplicity: floor(world_xyz/0.02), origin=(0,0,0); exact number of Gaussian CENTRES per occupied voxel, each occupied voxel weighted once. No empty voxels, splat-footprint rasterization or Gaussian weighting.

protocol.denominator_policy: baseline frozen camera-z support and mask, or candidate support for unpaired diagnostic; never candidate alpha/depth
protocol.floor_definition: nearest fixed reference has valid normal, abs(nz)>=threshold and lies below camera within frozen height band; geometric proxy includes ramps, cannot certify floor semantics/level identity
protocol.wall_definition: nearest fixed reference has valid normal, abs(nz)<=threshold and lies within fixed camera-height radius; geometric proxy may include columns/vehicles
protocol.up_axis: camera_init +Z assumed vertical; not independently surveyed
protocol.hole_rate: (missing_alpha + invalid_depth + wrong_depth + unknown_prediction)/fixed class support; not merely 1-alpha coverage
protocol.wrong_depth: alpha>0.5, finite positive depth, abs(predicted camera-z - fixed reference camera-z)>depth_tolerance_m; catches wrong layers even if opaque
protocol.unknown: unsupported pixels and unmatched/invalid-normal class labels are reported, never imputed as complete; unknown predictions remain in denominator and prohibit known/pass status
protocol.bidirectional_p50: 0.5*(median(render->full LiDAR nearest distance)+median(visible fixed LiDAR->render nearest distance)); NOT median of pooled directions, NOT global building Chamfer
protocol.frame_aggregation: Pixel-weighted render distances pooled across frames; reverse targets deduplicated within each frame then pooled across frames (the same reference point can be observed in several frames). No cross-frame render merging or distance sampling.
protocol.geometry_scope: covered fixed supported rays whose reference backprojection matches LiDAR within reference_match_max_m; reverse targets are unique nearest LiDAR records of all such fixed rays, including missing predictions
protocol.pixel_centres: NS/OpenGL pose and supplied NS intrinsics; both reference and render use x+.5,y+.5. This equals teacher CV integer pixels with cx_cv=cx_ns-.5,cy_cv=cy_ns-.5. Nondefault overrides are explicit diagnostics.

render_measurement.signed_error_definition: Predicted camera-z minus fixed reference camera-z, metres: negative nearer camera, positive farther. Conditional quantiles on finite positive depth with alpha>0.5 in fixed floor/wall classes. too_near/too_far use configured depth_tolerance_m (default +/-0.15m); rates use fixed class denominator; given_wrong fractions use wrong_depth count. Not world-height residual.

renderer_provenance.forward_contract: original ray-plane depth and low-pass coverage; no center-depth fallback

renderer_validation.forward_contract: original ray-plane depth and low-pass coverage; no center-depth fallback
renderer_validation.scope: Pinned native forward/derivative and real model integration evidence; CPU hashes only, no new GPU test or scene quality claim

export.verification: all field bytes exact; native opacity cutoff -5.5373; normalized wxyz; actual normals

checkpoint_export_proof.verification_scope: Rehashed complete CPU exact-export proof and source assets; tensor equality was verified by the separate CPU verifier, not recomputed here; no quality approval

baseline.parameter_origin: All Gaussian parameters replaced by source_ply; template checkpoint supplies model/backend and fixed source camera setup

conditioned_geometry.floor_front_surface_z_span_status: unknown: one expected-depth value cannot recover multilayer/front-surface thickness
unknown: one expected-depth value cannot recover multilayer/front-surface thickness

G7.seam_status: unknown: requires separate fixed boundary photometric evaluation

resource_usage.rss_platform: Linux ru_maxrss KiB converted to bytes

resource_policy: CPU only, <=4 query/BLAS threads; exact PLY counts; explicitly bounded allocations; no reference/model sampling. Sequential one-frame loading; only distance vectors retained.
limitations: Same initialization LiDAR and registration; never independent accuracy certification
Geometric floor/wall proxies, unverified floor labels and vertical axis
Unsupported and uncertain regions remain unknown; coverage is not whole-building completeness
Expected depth cannot establish front-layer thickness or absence of multiple layers
No gate decisions are made here; gate owner must verify frame/plan/protocol scope
